hero.headline: Manage proposals, experiments, and publications in one place
hero.support: Create a scientific project, submit it for review, schedule experiments, and invite collaborators.

steps.title: Propose
steps.body: Draft your project and proposal with clear scientific objectives.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Submit for scientific review and track approval status.

steps.title: Experiment
steps.body: Schedule instrument time and record experiment notes.

steps.title: Publish
steps.body: Link publications and mark the project complete.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.intro: ResearchHub lists fictional research facilities so teams can practice proposal workflows without a live beamline booking system.

items.name: North Ridge Light Laboratory
items.focus: Soft X-ray spectroscopy and materials science

items.name: Coastal Imaging Centre
items.focus: Imaging and structural biology support labs

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.intro: Instruments below are fictional stand-ins for beamlines and end-stations used when drafting experiment plans.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: ResearchHub follows a simple project lifecycle. Invalid status jumps are blocked on the server.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.body: Describe the science case and prepare a proposal while the project is still a draft.

steps.title: Submit for review
steps.body: Editors submit the proposal. Platform admins approve or reject from the admin app.

steps.title: Plan experiments
steps.body: After approval, schedule instruments and start experimental work.

steps.title: Publish and close
steps.body: Attach publications and mark the project complete when the campaign is done.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.intro: Public overview of ResearchHub concepts. Detailed API docs live with the backend team; this page is for researchers discovering the platform.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: Register with email and password. Sessions use JWT access and refresh tokens stored in this browser origin only.

sections.title: Projects & roles
sections.body: Owners manage invitations and collaborators. Editors can edit content; viewers have read-only access.

sections.title: Invitations
sections.body: Owners invite by email. Access is granted only after the invitee accepts with a matching account email.

sections.title: Admin review
sections.body: Platform admins approve or reject proposals from a separate admin application.
